image_description: A wide-angle interior shot of a church sanctuary. The central focus is a raised altar structure positioned at the end of a central aisle, flanked by wooden pews. The altar features a white frontal panel with a blue geometric emblem, topped with floral arrangements and candles. Behind the altar is a large statue on a pedestal, set against a dark curtain backdrop beneath a large arched stained-glass window. The architecture includes high walls with sconce lighting.
